description: Free: before paying, check whether a crypto pair is supported, on which exchange its candles come from (Binance.US, Kraken, Gate or MEXC, or the XRP Ledger DEX for xrpl: pairs) and which intervals the paid tools accept for it. Another dollar quote (USDT, USD, USDC) can stand in for the one you ask. Fetches no candles and returns no signal; for the daily trend use ichimoku_trend. Limited to 60 calls per hour.

pair.description: Crypto pair, e.g. BTC-USDT, SOL-USDT, TAO-USDT or ETHUSDT (Binance.US, then Kraken, Gate and MEXC: covers the top 200 coins). For the XRP Ledger DEX: xrpl:XRP-RLUSD, xrpl:SOLO-XRP, or with the issuer, xrpl:SOLO.rsoLo2S1kiGeCcn6hCUXVrCpGMWLrRrLZz-XRP
